common:generalComment.#text: Kraft pulping is the dominant manufacturing process by which wood chips are transformed into pulp, the intermediate material from which a broad spectrum of finished or semi-finished paper products are made. It involves the use of heat and chemicals to pulp wood chips for making paper, producing gaseous sulfur compounds called 'total reduced sulfur' or TRS gases. Wood chips are treated with a mixture of sodium hydroxide and sodium sulfide and cooked under high pressure to disintegrate the chips into smaller fibers. The resulting pulp is used to make paper products.
硫酸盐制浆是将木片转化为浆的主要制造过程，这是制造各种成品或半成品纸制品的中间材料。它涉及使用热量和化学品将木片制成纸浆，产生被称为'总还原硫'或TRS气体的气态硫化合物。木片用氢氧化钠和硫化钠的混合物处理，并在高压下煮熟，以将木片分解成较小的纤维。得到的浆用于制造纸制品。

common:generalComment.#text: Sheet steel is an alloy mainly made up of iron with small amounts of carbon, manganese, sulfur, phosphorus, and silicon. It is known for its strength, durability, and ability to be moulded into different shapes or forms. It can be cold-rolled or hot-rolled, depending on the application. Steel is a strong and versatile metal, with carbon directly influencing its strength and durability. Steel plate is a material commonly used in construction to create everyday objects like ship hulls.
钢板是一种合金，主要由铁与少量碳、锰、硫、磷和硅组成。它以强度高、经久耐用、可塑造成不同形状或形态而著称。根据用途的不同，钢可以冷轧或热轧。钢是一种坚固且用途广泛的金属，碳元素直接影响其强度和耐用性。钢板是一种建筑材料，常用于制造船体等日常物品。

common:generalComment.#text: A paper bag is a bag made of paper, usually kraft paper. They can be made either with virgin or recycled fibres. Paper bags are commonly used as shopping carrier bags and for packaging of some consumer goods. They are a type of packaging deemed less harmful than plastic bags. They are reusable, biodegradable and recyclable. Paper bags come in different shapes and sizes, with two basic types: open mouth and valve.
纸袋是由纸制成的袋子，通常是牛皮纸。它们可以由原生纤维或回收纤维制成。纸袋通常用作购物手提袋和包装一些消费品。它们被认为是比塑料袋更不有害的包装类型。它们是可重复使用的，可生物降解的和可回收的。纸袋有不同的形状和大小，有两种基本类型：开口和阀门。

common:generalComment.#text: Tap water refers to water that has been processed for safety and compliance with drinking water standards and is commonly supplied to households and industries via plumbing systems. It is treated to remove contaminants and pathogens, typically involving processes such as filtration, sedimentation, and disinfection. This water is ready for direct consumption or use in various applications 'to consumer' and 'at plant'. The specific treatment methods and quality can vary depending on the location and local water source.
自来水指的是经过处理，符合饮用水标准的水，通常通过管道系统供应给家庭和工业。它经过处理去除污染物和病原体，通常包括过滤、沉淀和消毒等过程。这种水可以直接饮用或用于各种应用，‘对消费者’和‘在工厂’。具体的处理方法和水质可能因地点和当地水源而异。

common:synonyms.#text: wood waste; waste wood; wood residues
废木材；木质废料；木材残余物

common:generalComment.#text: Wood waste is a significant component of municipal solid waste (MSW), accounting for 20-30% of all waste globally. It comes from various sources including furniture, durable goods, wood packaging, and miscellaneous products. Less than a third of this waste is recycled. Despite this, wood waste is a valuable resource, contributing to natural resource conservation, energy efficiency, industrial economics, reforestation, job creation, and climate change mitigation.
木材垃圾是城市固体废物的重要组成部分，占全球所有垃圾的20-30%。它来自各种来源，包括家具、耐用品、木包装和杂项产品。这些废物中只有不到三分之一被回收利用。尽管如此，木材废料还是一种宝贵的资源，有助于自然资源保护、能源效率、工业经济、重新造林、创造就业机会和缓解气候变化。

common:generalComment.#text: 本数据集描述了1-35kV中压交流电的产品流，从电力生产、传输到最终供应给使用电力的用户。该数据集专为用户侧的电力使用而设计，反映了多种电力来源的混合，包括化石燃料、核能和可再生能源等不同发电方式的组合。数据集符合国际生命周期数据系统 (ILCD) 的相关规定，满足方法学、数据质量、命名规范、审核和文档等方面的要求，确保数据的准确性和适用性，特别是针对电力用户的环境影响评估。

This dataset describes the product flow of 1-35kV medium voltage alternating current (MVAC) electricity from the point of generation, through transmission, to the final supply to the consumers who use the electricity. The dataset is designed for customer-side electricity use and reflects a mix of multiple electricity sources, including a combination of different generation methods such as fossil fuels, nuclear and renewable energy. The dataset is compliant with the International Life Cycle Data (ILCD) system and meets methodology, data quality, naming conventions, auditing and documentation requirements to ensure accuracy and applicability of the data, particularly for environmental impact assessment of electricity users.

common:synonyms.#text: iron oxide colorant; ferric oxide pigment
氧化铁着色剂；三氧化二铁颜料

common:generalComment.#text: Iron oxide pigment refers to a type of coloring agent derived from iron oxide compounds. These pigments are widely used to provide color to various materials, including paints, coatings, plastics, ceramics, concrete, and more. They come in different shades of red, yellow, brown, and black, depending on the specific type of iron oxide used. Iron oxide pigments are known for their stability, durability, and resistance to fading over time.
氧化铁颜料是指一种从氧化铁化合物中提取的着色剂。这些颜料被广泛用于为油漆、涂料、塑料、陶瓷、混凝土等各种材料着色。根据所使用氧化铁的具体类型，它们有红色、黄色、棕色和黑色等不同色调。氧化铁颜料以其稳定性、耐久性和抗褪色性著称。

common:generalComment.#text: Hydraulic fluid's main function in hydraulic systems is to transmit power from one part of a system to another. It converts mechanical energy into hydraulic pressure, which is uniformly distributed throughout the fluid. The pressure can move pistons or cylinders, which in turn move other parts of the system. Hydraulic fluid is a non-compressible, engineered medium that provides lubrication and heat and power transfer properties. It is composed of a base oil, which can be mineral or synthetic, along with various performance-enhancing additives.
液压流体在液压系统中的主要功能是将动力从系统的一个部分传递到另一个部分。它将机械能转化为液压，液压均匀分布在整个流体中。压力可以移动活塞或气缸，进而移动系统的其他部分。液压流体是一种不可压缩的工程介质，具有润滑、传热和动力传递特性。它由矿物油或合成基础油以及各种性能增强添加剂组成。

common:generalComment.#text: Diesel fuel is the common term for the distillate fuel oil sold for use in motor vehicles that use the compression ignition engine named for its inventor, Rudolf Diesel. Diesel fuel is refined from crude oil and biomass materials, and has different sulfur content depending on its use and location. Diesel is the predominant fuel used for shipping goods and moving freight across the country and around the world.
柴油是一种常见的蒸馏燃料油的术语，用于销售给使用压燃发动机的汽车，该发动机以其发明者鲁道夫·柴油命名。柴油是从原油和生物质材料中提炼出来的，其硫含量根据使用和位置的不同而不同。柴油是运输货物和运输货物穿越全国和世界的主要燃料。

common:generalComment.#text: Gravel sand refers to aggregate of more or less rounded rock fragments coarser than sand, typically more than 2 mm in diameter. It is a natural material. Gravel is a widely used building material, often combined with a binding medium to form materials like asphalt concrete and Portland cement concrete. Crushed gravel is also available in various sizes for different applications, such as filling large holes.
砾石砂是指或多或少圆形岩石碎片的骨料，其比沙子更粗糙，通常直径超过2毫米。它是一种天然材料。砾石是一种广泛使用的建筑材料，通常与粘结介质结合形成沥青混凝土和硅酸盐水泥混凝土等材料。碎砾石也有各种尺寸可用于不同的应用，例如填充孔洞。

common:generalComment.#text: 本数据集描述了＜1kV低压交流电的产品流，从电力生产、传输到最终供应给使用电力的用户。该数据集专为用户侧的电力使用而设计，反映了多种电力来源的混合，包括化石燃料、核能和可再生能源等不同发电方式的组合。数据集符合国际生命周期数据系统 (ILCD) 的相关规定，满足方法学、数据质量、命名规范、审核和文档等方面的要求，确保数据的准确性和适用性，特别是针对电力用户的环境影响评估。

This dataset describes the product flow of low voltage alternating current (LVAC) electricity from ＜1kV, from the production and transmission of the electricity to its final supply to the consumers who use it. The dataset is designed for customer-side electricity use and reflects a mix of multiple electricity sources, including a combination of different generation methods such as fossil fuels, nuclear and renewable energy. The dataset is compliant with the International Life Cycle Data (ILCD) system and meets methodology, data quality, naming conventions, auditing and documentation requirements to ensure accuracy and applicability of the data, particularly for environmental impact assessment of electricity users.

common:generalComment.#text: Polyethylene is a plastic film made from ethylene, a hydrocarbon mainly obtained from natural gas or oil. It is commonly used in packaging for pharmaceuticals, household chemicals, and food items. There are different types of polyethylene film, influenced by the degree and form of side branching from the polymer chain. Polyethylene terephthalates are solid forms of polyester, and rival polyethylene in packaging applications.
聚乙烯是一种由乙烯制成的塑料薄膜，乙烯是一种碳氢化合物，主要从天然气或石油中提取。它常用于药品、家用化学品和食品的包装。聚乙烯薄膜有不同的类型，受聚合物链的侧枝程度和形式的影响。聚对苯二甲酸乙二醇酯是聚酯的固态形式，在包装应用中可与聚乙烯相媲美。

common:synonyms.#text: 未涂布印刷书写纸；未涂布包装纸
uncoated printing and writing paper; uncoated packaging paper

common:generalComment.#text: Uncoated paper is typically less expensive and absorbs more ink than coated paper. It is often used for a company's matching letterhead, envelope, business cards and other collateral items. The paper is manufactured without a coating, allowing the ink to be absorbed into the paper, rather than sitting on top in a defined dot. This type of paper is ideal for writing as it is easier to use a pen or pencil on uncoated paper compared to coated paper.
未涂层纸张通常比涂层纸张便宜，且能吸收更多的墨水。它经常被用于公司的配套信头纸、信封、名片和其他宣传品。这种纸张在制造过程中没有涂层，允许墨水被纸张吸收，而不是以明确的点状停留在表面。这种纸张非常适合书写，因为使用笔或铅笔在未涂层纸张上比在涂层纸张上更容易。

common:generalComment.#text: Cotton is a seed-hair fibre of several species of plants of the genus Gossypium, belonging to the hibiscus, or mallow, family (Malvaceae). It is one of the world's leading agricultural crops, plentiful and economically produced. Cotton is a soft, fluffy staple fiber that grows in a boll, or protective case, around the seeds of the cotton plants. It is a staple textile of the fashion industry and the most widely produced natural fiber on the planet.
棉花是属于木槿或锦葵科（锦葵属）的棉属植物中多个品种的籽毛纤维。它是世界主要农作物之一，产量丰富且经济实惠。棉花是一种柔软、蓬松的短纤维，生长在棉铃或棉花种子周围的保护壳中。它是时装业的主要纺织品，也是地球上生产最广泛的天然纤维。

common:generalComment.#text: Solid waste refers to any garbage, refuse, sludge from a wastewater treatment plant, water supply treatment plant, or air pollution control facility and other discarded material. This dataset describes the product flow of 35-330kV high-voltage alternating current (AC) electricity from the point of generation, through transmission, to the final supply to the consumer who uses the electricity. The dataset is designed for customer-side use of electricity and reflects a mix of multiple sources of electricity, including a combination of different generation methods such as fossil fuels, nuclear energy, and renewable energy. The dataset is compliant with the International Life Cycle Data (ILCD) system and meets methodology, data quality, naming conventions, auditing and documentation requirements to ensure the accuracy and applicability of the data, particularly for environmental impact assessments of electricity users.

common:generalComment.#text: Lubricating oil, sometimes simply called lubricant/lube, is a class of oils used to reduce the friction, heat, and wear between mechanical components that are in contact with each other. It is used in motorized vehicles, where it is known specifically as motor oil and transmission fluid. Petroleum-derived lubricating oil is a mixture produced by atmospheric and vacuum distillation of selected paraffinic and naphthenic crude oils, after which chemical changes may be required to produce the desired properties of the refined product.
润滑油，有时简称为润滑剂/润滑油，是一类用于减少相互接触的机械部件之间的摩擦、热量和磨损的油类。它主要用于机动车辆，具体称为机油和传动液。石油衍生润滑油是一种通过大气蒸馏和真空蒸馏精选石蜡原油和环烷原油而制成的混合物，之后可能需要进行化学变化，以获得所需的精炼产品特性。

common:generalComment.#text: Sodium hydroxide (NaOH), also known as caustic soda or lye, is a corrosive white crystalline solid that contains the sodium cation and the hydroxide anion. It readily absorbs moisture until it dissolves. It is the most widely used industrial alkali and is often used in drain and oven cleaners. Sodium hydroxide is a co-product of chlorine production. It is a highly versatile substance used in a variety of manufacturing processes. In 1807, Sir Humphry Davy became the first to prepare sodium in its elemental form, applying electrolysis to fused sodium hydroxide.

common:generalComment.#text: Corrugated cardboard is a packaging material consisting of at least three sheets of corrugated fiberboard. It is made from linerboard and a medium, which is fluted paper glued between linerboard sheets. Known for its durability, cost-effectiveness, and versatility, corrugated cardboard is often used for making boxes. It is renewable, with a high percentage of recycled content, and can be made from paper pulp from fast-growing pine trees or from wood chips and other leftover materials. Corrugated cardboard features a distinctive wave-like structure and comes in various flute profiles, such as C Flute, E Flute, and F Flute, which differ in thickness and flute density.
瓦楞纸板是一种包装材料，至少由三张瓦楞纤维板组成。它由衬纸和介质制成，介质是粘在衬纸之间的凹槽纸。瓦楞纸板以其耐用性、成本效益和多功能性而著称，常用于制作纸箱。瓦楞纸板是一种可再生材料，可回收成分比例很高，可以用生长迅速的松树的纸浆或木屑和其他剩余材料制成。瓦楞纸板具有独特的波浪状结构，有各种不同的楞型，如 C 型楞、E 型楞和 F 型楞，它们的厚度和楞的密度各不相同。

common:generalComment.#text: Mineral oil is a colorless, transparent, oily liquid derived from crude petroleum oil. It is utilized for various purposes including treating dry skin, constipation, eczema, cradle cap, and facilitating bowel movements. Mineral oil is also a by-product from the refining of crude oil and the manufacturing of gasoline and petroleum products. It is odorless and used in cosmetics, science labs, industrial settings, and more. Despite its industrial origins, it has applications in the kitchen and is a refined petroleum oil used as a laxative.
矿物油是一种由原油衍生而来的无色透明油状液体。它用于各种目的，包括治疗皮肤干燥、便秘、湿疹、乳痂和促进排便。矿物油也是原油精炼以及汽油和石油产品制造的副产品。它无味，用于化妆品、科学实验室、工业环境等。尽管它起源于工业，但它在厨房中也有应用，是一种用作泻药的精炼石油。

common:generalComment.#text: An offcut or off-cut is material left over after a workpiece is cut or processed, such as in masonry, metalworking, woodworking, industrial or domestic food processing, and textile manufacturing. An offcut is waste material which can sometimes be reused, recycled, or sold as scrap.

common:generalComment.#text: Sawdust is a byproduct of the lumber industry, created when wood is cut or milled into lumber. It comprises tiny wood particles ranging from fine dust to small chips. Commonly used as a fuel source, sawdust can also serve as a soil amendment. It is particularly beneficial for low-pH crops like blueberries, strawberries, and raspberries, acting as an inexpensive mulch option. Sawdust's powdery texture and light brown or gray color result from the sawing, sanding, or grinding of wood during processing.
木屑是木材工业的副产品，是在木材被切割或研磨成木材时产生的。它由细小的木屑颗粒组成，从细小的灰尘到细小的碎屑。木屑通常用作燃料来源，也可以用作土壤改良剂。它对蓝莓、草莓和树莓等低pH作物特别有益，是一种廉价的覆盖物。木屑的粉状质地和浅棕色或灰色是在加工过程中锯切、打磨或研磨木材产生的。

common:generalComment.#text: Solvent ink refers to printing ink made of various oil-based solvents (volatile organic compounds). It is used for a wide range of printing solutions due to its capability to print on unlimited surfaces. Solvent-based inks are popular in the printing market due to their amazing print quality. The ink is dissolved in another substance, which can be glycol ether esters or glycol esters and their derivatives. Water is not used to dissolve the ink. The printing industry categorizes this type of ink based on the amount of heat that is necessary to dry the solvent once it is applied on the medium.
溶剂油墨是指由各种油基溶剂（挥发性有机化合物）制成的印刷油墨。由于其能在无限的表面上打印，因此被广泛用于各种印刷解决方案。由于其出色的打印质量，溶剂型油墨在印刷市场上非常受欢迎。油墨是溶解在另一种物质中，这种物质可以是乙二醇醚酯或乙二醇酯及其衍生物。水不用于溶解油墨。印刷行业根据在介质上应用溶剂后，需要多少热量来干燥溶剂，对这种类型的油墨进行分类。

common:generalComment.#text: Starch is a white, granular, organic chemical produced by all green plants. It is a polysaccharide composed of glucose monomers linked in α 1,4 linkages. Starch is utilized in the food, paper, and textile industries and is a staple carbohydrate in the human diet. It serves as an energy store in plants and is biodegradable. Starch is the most commonly consumed type of carbohydrate and an important energy source, found in cereal grains and root vegetables.
淀粉是一种由所有绿色植物产生的白色颗粒状有机化学物质。它是一种多糖，由以 α 1,4 连接方式连接的葡萄糖单体组成。淀粉可用于食品、造纸和纺织工业，也是人类饮食中的主要碳水化合物。它是植物的能量储存剂，可生物降解。淀粉是最常见的碳水化合物，也是重要的能量来源，存在于谷物和根茎类蔬菜中。

Clay materials are plastic when wet and coherent when dry. Clay minerals are a group of hydrous aluminosilicates that are formed from the weathering and alteration of silicate minerals.

common:generalComment.#text: Coating is a process that occurs during paper manufacturing to give paper a professional appearance and protect it from scuffing and rubbing. It comes in gloss, matte, or varnish forms. Varnish is a clear, transparent coating applied to a printed piece during or after printing to protect the printed material against fingerprints, smudges, and scuffs, and enhance the packaging's colors and overall appearance. Aqueous coating (AQ) is a transparent, water-based varnish applied during the printing process. It dries quickly, resists fingerprints, is environmentally friendly, and supports unique packaging designs.
涂层是纸张制造过程中的一个环节，用于赋予纸张专业外观并保护其免受擦伤和摩擦。涂层有光泽、哑光或清漆等形式。清漆是一种透明的涂层，用于在印刷过程中或印刷后应用于印刷品，以保护印刷材料免受指纹、污渍和擦伤的影响，并增强包装的颜色和整体外观。水性涂层（AQ）是在印刷过程中应用的透明、水基清漆。它干燥速度快，抵抗指纹，环保，并支持独特的包装设计。

common:generalComment.#text: Refractory bricks are materials capable of maintaining structural and performance stability under high-temperature conditions. They are commonly used as linings in high-temperature industrial equipment such as kilns, furnaces, and boilers. Made primarily from high-alumina, silica, or magnesia-based materials, refractory bricks are manufactured through high-temperature firing. They are characterized by high heat resistance, thermal shock resistance, and strong chemical stability, making them widely used in industries such as metallurgy, construction materials, and chemicals.
耐火砖是一种能够在高温环境下保持结构和性能稳定的材料，通常用于高温工业设备如窑炉、熔炉和锅炉内衬。其主要原材料包括高铝矿物、硅质材料和镁质材料，通过高温烧制而成。耐火砖具有高耐热性、抗热震性以及较强的化学稳定性，在冶金、建材、化工等行业中广泛应用。

common:generalComment.#text: Hydraulic fluid's main function in hydraulic systems is to transmit power from one part of a system to another. It converts mechanical energy into hydraulic pressure, which is uniformly distributed throughout the fluid. The pressure can move pistons or cylinders, which in turn move other parts of the system. Hydraulic fluid is a non-compressible, engineered medium that provides lubrication and heat and power transfer properties. It is composed of a base oil, which can be mineral or synthetic, along with various performance-enhancing additives.
液压流体在液压系统中的主要功能是将动力从系统的一个部分传递到另一个部分。它将机械能转化为液压，液压均匀分布在整个流体中。压力可以移动活塞或气缸，进而移动系统的其他部分。液压流体是一种不可压缩的工程介质，具有润滑、传热和动力传递特性。它由矿物油或合成基础油以及各种性能增强添加剂组成。

There are many advantages of road transport in comparison to other means of transport.

common:generalComment.#text: Calcium hydroxide, also called slaked lime or hydrated lime, is a soft white powder widely used as a raw material in the chemical industry. It forms when calcium oxide is mixed with water. The compound has two hydroxide ions for each ion of calcium. The chemical is ionic, with aqueous and electrolytic dissociations both producing calcium ions and hydroxide ions. It is an inorganic compound which has a white, powdery appearance in its solid-state. However, in its crystalline form, it has a colorless appearance.

common:generalComment.#text: Anhydrous sodium sulfate is a type of sodium sulfate mineral that does not contain water. It belongs to the monoclinic crystal system, and its crystals are biconical, prismatic, or tabular. Aggregates are granular, powdery, or in block form. It can be colorless, grayish-white, yellow, or yellow-brown, and ranges from transparent to translucent. It exhibits a vitreous or resinous luster, with a white streak. It has a hardness of 2.5-3 and a density of 2.66-2.7g/cm3. Anhydrous sodium sulfate is highly soluble in water and imparts a cooling sensation. It has a cool and slightly salty taste. In humid air, it easily undergoes hydration, transforming into a powdery form of hydrated sodium sulfate on the surface. Anhydrous sodium sulfate is found in salt lakes containing sodium sulfate brine, where it coexists with mirabilite, gypsum, thenardite, bloedite, glauberite, halite, and trona. It can also be dehydrated from mirabilite, and small amounts can be found around volcanic fumaroles.

元明粉是一种不含水的钠硫酸盐矿物。斜方晶系，晶体呈双锥状、柱状或板状，集合体呈粒状、粉末状或块状。无色、灰白色、黄色或黄棕色。透明至半透明。玻璃光泽或松脂光泽。条痕白色。硬度2.5～3，密度2.66～2.7g/cm3。极易溶于水。有凉感。味清凉而带咸。在潮湿空气中易水化，转变成粉末状含水硫酸钠覆盖于表面。无水芒硝产于含硫酸钠卤水的盐湖中，与芒硝、钙芒硝、泻利盐白钠镁矾、石膏、盐镁芒硝、石盐、泡碱等共生；也可由芒硝脱水而成；火山喷气孔周围有少量产出。

common:generalComment.#text: Calcium oxide (CaO), also known as quicklime or lime, is a compound of one atom of calcium and one atom of oxygen. It is a white or grayish white solid produced in large quantities by roasting calcium carbonate to drive off carbon dioxide. At room temperature, it will spontaneously absorb carbon dioxide from the atmosphere. It is a widely used material and is a white, caustic, alkaline solid at room temperature.
氧化钙（CaO）又称生石灰或石灰，是由一个钙原子和一个氧原子组成的化合物。它是一种白色或灰白色固体，通过焙烧碳酸钙以驱除二氧化碳而大量生成。在室温下，它会自发吸收大气中的二氧化碳。它是一种广泛使用的材料，在室温下呈白色、腐蚀性、碱性固体。

common:generalComment.#text: Sulfuric acid is a highly corrosive strong mineral acid with a chemical formula H2SO4. It is colorless to slightly yellow in liquid form and is soluble in water at all concentrations. The acid is used in various applications including mineral processing, fertilizer manufacturing, oil refining, waste water processing, and chemical synthesis. It is produced through the contact process by the oxidation of sulfur trioxide, which is further hydrated with water. Sulfuric acid is available commercially at various concentrations and can be found in both industrial and laboratory settings.

common:generalComment.#text: Aluminium scrap is the most essential input material to the recycling process. It is often categorised as 'new scrap' from production processes and 'old scrap' from post consumer use. New scrap arises during the manufacturing of aluminium semi-fabricated and final products. Old scrap refers to those products collected after use. It can be found in residential items like folding lawn chairs and commercial items like airplanes.

common:generalComment.#text: Hot rolled steel is a type of steel that is formed using the hot rolling process at a temperature above its recrystallization temperature. It is easier to shape at this elevated temperature and typically does not require any post-forming heat treatment. It is processed at high temperatures, improving malleability and strength. Due to the higher temperatures, hot-rolled steel is much more workable than cold-rolled steel, making it suitable for applications requiring complex shapes.

common:generalComment.#text: Deionised water is water that has had its ions removed. It is produced through a process that filters out minerals and ions such as calcium, sodium, iron, copper, chloride, and bromide. It has no set standard compliance but is often produced to meet specific quality criteria required for certain industrial or laboratory processes. Deionised water is typically used in applications where the presence of ions may interfere with machinery, experiments, or manufacturing processes, such as in cooling applications, laboratory tests, or electronics manufacturing. The production route involves ion exchange, reverse osmosis, or distillation. The product may be supplied as part of a production or consumption mix and is available at the production plant or to the consumer.
去离子水是通过去除了其离子的水。它通过过滤掉矿物质及离子如钙、钠、铁、铜、氯化物和溴化物的过程产生。它没有设定的标准遵从性，但通常生产出来以满足某些工业或实验室过程所需的特定质量标准。去离子水通常应用于离子存在可能干扰机械、实验或制造过程的地方，例如在冷却应用、实验室测试或电子制造中。其生产路线包括离子交换、反渗透或蒸馏。该产品可能作为生产或消费混合物供应，且可在生产工厂或消费者那里获得。

common:generalComment.#text: Activated carbon, also called activated charcoal, is a form of carbon used to filter contaminants from water and air. It is processed to have small, low-volume pores that increase the surface area for adsorption or chemical reactions. It is typically made from wood, but can also be made using bamboo, coconut husk, peat, woods, coir, lignite, coal, pitch, and other dense carbon sources. It is a rough, imperfectly structured kind of graphite with a wide spectrum of pores of varying sizes.
活性炭又称活性炭，是一种用于过滤水和空气中污染物的碳。经过加工，活性炭具有小而体积小的孔隙，从而增加了吸附或化学反应的表面积。它通常由木材制成，但也可以用竹子、椰子壳、泥炭、木材、椰壳纤维、褐煤、煤、沥青和其他致密碳源制成。它是一种结构粗糙、不完美的石墨，具有大小不一的各种孔隙。

common:generalComment.#text: Concrete is an artificial composite material, comprising a matrix of cementitious binder (typically Portland cement paste or asphalt) and a dispersed phase or 'filler' of aggregate (typically a rocky material, loose stones, and sand). The binder 'glues' the filler together to form a synthetic conglomerate. It is used for various structural purposes, made by mixing cement and various aggregates, as sand, pebbles, gravel, or shale, with water and allowing the mixture to harden.
混凝土是一种人工复合材料，由水泥基粘结剂（通常为波特兰水泥浆或沥青）和分散相或 "填料 "骨料（通常为岩石材料、松散石块和沙子）组成。粘合剂将填料 "粘合 "在一起，形成合成砾石。它用于各种结构目的，通过将水泥和各种骨料（如沙子、卵石、砾石或页岩）与水混合并使混合物硬化制成。

common:generalComment.#text: Clinker is a primary product used in the production of cement, characterized by its nodular form resulting from the sintering of limestone and clay. It's processed through a high-temperature kiln, is compliant with industry quality standards, is utilized as a key component in the manufacturing of Portland cement, is produced via the calcination route, with limestone as the main raw material. It is typically provided in a form that is ready to be ground to make cement, to consumer or at plant.

common:generalComment.#text: Polyester resin is a type of high-molecular compound synthesized through polycondensation reactions of polyacids (such as phthalic anhydride and terephthalic acid) and polyols (such as ethylene glycol and propylene glycol). According to its chemical structure, it can be divided into two major categories: unsaturated polyester resin (UPR, containing unsaturated double bonds, and can be cross-linked and cured at room temperature) and saturated polyester resin (without unsaturated bonds, requiring high temperature or special curing agents). It is one of the most widely used thermosetting/thermoplastic resins. Its core feature is that unsaturated polyester resin has the advantages of fast curing at room temperature, simple molding process (suitable for hand lay-up, compression molding, pultrusion, spray molding and other processes), economic cost, and good compatibility with reinforcing materials such as glass fiber. After curing, it has certain mechanical strength, corrosion resistance and insulation. Saturated polyester resin is characterized by excellent weather resistance, resistance to chemical medium corrosion and gloss stability. This material is widely used in the field of composite materials (such as base materials for wind turbine blades, fiberglass reinforced plastic products, and lightweight automotive components), the coatings industry (coil coatings, automotive topcoats, anti-corrosion coatings), adhesives, artificial stone (artificial marble, quartz stone), and electronic packaging, among other scenarios. Among them, unsaturated polyester resin is favored for its high cost performance and flexible molding It is a commonly used base resin for reinforcing composite materials of wind turbine blades and photovoltaic module frames, meeting the weather resistance and mechanical performance requirements for long-term outdoor use of new energy facilities. It is a core polymer material that takes into account practicality, economy and processing adaptability.

聚酯树脂是一类以多元酸（如邻苯二甲酸酐、对苯二甲酸）与多元醇（如乙二醇、丙二醇）通过缩聚反应合成的高分子化合物，按化学结构可分为不饱和聚酯树脂（UPR，含不饱和双键，可常温交联固化）与饱和聚酯树脂（无不饱和键，需高温或特殊固化剂）两大类，是应用最广泛的热固性 / 热塑性树脂之一。其核心特性为不饱和聚酯树脂兼具常温固化快、成型工艺简单（适配手糊、模压、拉挤、喷射等工艺）、成本经济、与玻璃纤维等增强材料相容性好的优势，固化后具备一定的机械强度、耐腐蚀性与绝缘性；饱和聚酯树脂则以优异的耐候性、耐化学介质腐蚀及光泽稳定性为特点。该材料广泛应用于复合材料领域（如风电叶片基体材料、玻璃钢制品、汽车轻量化部件）、涂料工业（卷材涂料、汽车面漆、防腐涂料）、胶粘剂、人造石材（人造大理石、石英石）及电子封装等场景，其中不饱和聚酯树脂因性价比高、成型灵活，是风电叶片、光伏组件边框增强复合材料的常用基体树脂，适配新能源设施户外长期使用的耐候性与力学性能需求，是兼顾实用性、经济性与加工适配性的核心高分子材料。

common:generalComment.#text: Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) is a product flow characterized by being a flammable mixture of hydrocarbon gases used as fuel in heating appliances, cooking equipment, and vehicles. It typically contains processing levels involving refining and condensation, adherence to safety and quality standards, and is commonly used as a heating source or automotive fuel. The production involves the separation and collection of gases during natural gas purification or oil refining, with educt names including propane and butane. It can be part of both production and consumption mixes and is available in cylinders or bulk for various sectors like domestic, commercial, and industrial 'to consumer', or 'at plant'.
液化石油气 (LPG) 是一种可燃的碳氢化合物气体混合物，用作加热器具、烹饪设备和车辆的燃料。它通常包括提炼和冷凝的处理水平，符合安全和质量标准，并且常作为加热源或者汽车燃料使用。其生产过程包括在天然气净化或油品精炼过程中分离和收集气体，原料名称包括丙烷和丁烷。它可以是生产和消费混合物的一部分，并且以气瓶或散装的形式为家庭、商业和工业等不同领域提供 '给消费者' 或 '在工厂'。

nonwoven fabric; non-woven fabric; nonwoven textile

common:generalComment.#text: Nonwoven fabric is a fabric-like material made from staple fibre and long fibres bonded together by chemical, mechanical, or heat processes. It has various properties such as strength, durability, absorbency, breathability, and cost-effectiveness. It is used in various industries including medical, geotextile, automotive, filtration, packaging, apparel, and home furnishings. It can be made from polymers, such as polypropylene or viscose rayon, and is often used in disposable products, such as napkins and wipes, but also in more durable products like roofing materials and geotextiles.
无纺布是一种由短纤维和长纤维通过化学、机械或热处理过程粘合在一起的类似织物的材料。它具有各种性能，如强度、耐用性、吸水性、透气性和成本效益。它在各种行业中都有应用，包括医疗、土工布、汽车、过滤、包装、服装和家居装饰。它可以由聚合物（如聚丙烯或粘胶纤维）制成，常用于一次性产品（如餐巾和湿巾），但也用于更耐用的产品，如屋顶材料和土工布。

treatmentStandardsRoutes.#text: high temperature sintering of magnesium raw materials

common:synonyms.#text: 烧成镁质砖；烧结镁砖；镁砖
fired magnesite brick; burnt magnesite brick; magnesia brick

common:generalComment.#text: Fired magnesite brick, often referred to simply as magnesia brick, is a widely used alkaline brick. It is manufactured with magnesite as the raw material after smashing, burdening, mulling and molding through firing in the high temperature of 1550~1600℃. High purity products' firing temperature is over 1750℃. The mass fraction of MgO in magnesia is between 89% and 98%. The limit particle size is generally 3 to 5mm.
经过烧制的镁质砖，通常简称为镁砖，是一种广泛使用的碱性砖。它是以镁石为原料，经过粉碎、装料、混磨和成型，通过在1550~1600℃的高温下烧制而成。高纯度产品的烧制温度超过1750℃。镁砖中MgO的质量分数在89%和98%之间。限制粒径通常为3至5毫米。

common:generalComment.#text: Gypsum board is a specific board with a gypsum core and a paper facing. It is also known as wallboard, plasterboard, or Sheetrock. It is a convenient alternative to plaster used for interior walls and ceilings. The board is made of gypsum plaster sandwiched between heavy paper or fiberglass surface sheets. It becomes strong and rigid once dried and is ready for use as a building material.
石膏板是一种具有石膏核心和纸面的特定板材。它也被称为墙板、石膏板或者Sheetrock。它是用于内墙和天花板的石膏的便捷替代品。该板材由石膏石膏夹在重纸或玻璃纤维表面板之间制成。一旦干燥，它会变得坚固且刚性，准备用作建筑材料。

baseName.#text: Plywood consisting solely of sheets, with at least one outer ply of tropical wood
胶合板仅由板材组成，外层至少有一层热带木材

common:generalComment.#text: - plywood is a panel consisting of an assembly of veneer sheets of tropical wood bonded together with the direction of the grain in alternate plies generally at right angles. The veneer sheets are usually placed symmetrically on both sides of a central ply or core that may itself be made from a veneer sheet or another material. It includes veneer plywood, core plywood or blockboard, cellular board and composite plywood. It excludes laminated construction materials (e.g. glulam), where the grain of the veneer sheets generally runs in the same direction.

胶合板是一种由多层热带木单板组装而成的板材，各层单板纤维方向在相邻层之间通常呈直角交错排列。单板通常以中心层或芯层为对称中心，分别铺设在其两侧，该中心层或芯层本身可以由单板或其他材料制成。胶合板包括单板胶合板、芯板胶合板或木芯板（blockboard）、空心板（cellular board）和复合胶合板（composite plywood）。不包括层压结构材料（如胶合木 glulam），此类材料中各层单板的纤维方向通常基本一致。

Currency unit group extended for EEIO and CEEIO monetary product flows. For version 03.01.000, the reference unit EUR is interpreted as EUR_2000. Year-labelled EUR units are expressed in EUR_2000 with Eurostat HICP annual average index, euro area all-items (prc_hicp_aind, unit=INX_A_AVG, coicop=CP00, geo=EA). Year-labelled USD and CNY units are expressed in EUR_2000 by deflating local currency to year-2000 value with World Bank WDI FP.CPI.TOTL and then applying the World Bank WDI PA.NUS.FCRF 2000 annual average official exchange rate. These generic currency units do not encode sector-specific purchaser-price, producer-price, or IO price-index adjustments.

为 EEIO 和 CEEIO 货币产品流扩展的货币单位组。 在 03.01.000 版本中，参考单位 EUR 解释为 EUR_2000。 带年份的 EUR 单位使用 Eurostat 欧元区全部项目 HICP 年平均指数折算为 EUR_2000（prc_hicp_aind, unit=INX_A_AVG, coicop=CP00, geo=EA）。 带年份的 USD 和 CNY 单位先用 World Bank WDI FP.CPI.TOTL 将本币折回 2000 年价值，再用 World Bank WDI PA.NUS.FCRF 2000 年官方年平均汇率折算为 EUR_2000。 这些通用货币单位不编码部门特定的购买者价格、生产者价格或投入产出价格指数调整。
